summary_md:
# Återköp är som fredagsvin - trevligt i rätt mängd

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-04-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Dagens Industri's analysis desk reviews a busy Q1 reporting week while the Stockholm market falls for a fifth straight day on renewed Iran-US tension and oil at $106. The hosts think the reporting season is broadly better than feared. Industrials such as ABB, Volvo, SKF and Trelleborg, plus the banks, beat lowered expectations, and the market is punishing small misses less than in earlier seasons. The main negative story is Electrolux's SEK 9bn rights issue, which reverses what management said in December. Other weak reports came from Indutrade, Betsson and Dynavox; Boozt, Mycronic and Vitrolife were singled out as strong.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 VOLV-B — Volvo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host's 'long' pick: strong truck orders, raised 2026 market outlooks, could return to profit growth in 2026.

#### Reasoning

Robban picked Volvo as his long. Order intake of ~74k trucks was >10% above expectations and the company raised outlooks for Europe and South America after raising US/China last quarter. Profit fell 15%, but hosts expect profit growth in 2026, possibly breaking a 9-quarter decline streak by Q2.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake reverses
- if 2026 profit growth fails to materialise
- if Iran war triggers recession

> *"Så en lång Volvo."*

---

### 🔴 SIVE — Sivers | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host's 'short' pick: stock has run up irrationally, 22% borrow cost, expected to fall ≥23%.

#### Reasoning

Robban picked Sivers as his short. He calls the rally 'completely crazy' and thinks the stock will fall at least 23% at some point, which would cover the 22% cost of borrowing the shares.

#### Sell Triggers

- if fundamentals justify the valuation
- if the rally continues and borrow costs rise further

> *"Men jag tror att man kan få igen det, för den kommer falla 23 minst nån gång."*

---

### 🟢 ABB — ABB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Data-centre orders doubled, ~10% of business, good margins, raised outlook; Ulf's intended 'kanon'.

#### Reasoning

Hosts call ABB the star of the season and a new European AI winner through data-centre electrification. Ulf had planned to name it his 'kanon'. The only caution raised is that AI growth could slow eventually.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre/AI capex growth slows
- if margins deteriorate

> *"ABB, återigen stjärnan. ABB är helt otroligt."*

---

### 🟢 BOOZT — Boozt | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Robban's 'kanon': better margin, full-year margin guide raised 0.3pp, stock +8%, low valuation multiples.

#### Reasoning

Growth was modest at 4%, but margins beat and guidance was raised, partly helped by FX. The stock had been weak and trades on low multiples, so a small organic growth pickup plus higher margin could re-rate it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin gains prove only currency-driven
- if organic growth stalls

> *"jag tyckte faktiskt att Boosts rapport idag var riktigt bra"*

---

### ⛔ INDT — Indutrade | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Robban's 'kalkon': -10% on report, 5 quarters without organic sales growth, badly lagging serial-acquirer peers.

#### Reasoning

Robban has been critical for over a year. Indutrade is down 1% in five years while Lagercrantz, Addtech and Lifco are up >100% on average. It has 10 quarters without organic EBIT growth and weaker ROC, and owners question the CEO; the chair must prove she can turn it around.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth returns
- if management change drives a turnaround

> *"Så det är en väldigt svag utveckling för Indutrade."*

---

### 🟢 MYCR — Mycronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Ulf's 'kanon': raised 2026 outlook, orders and profit up >20%, very profitable.

#### Reasoning

Ulf calls it a 'kanon' report despite the stock's strong run this year. Management dared to raise the 2026 outlook already in Q1, even though results swing a lot between quarters.

#### Sell Triggers

- if quarterly order volatility turns negative
- if 2026 guidance is cut

> *"Så då tar jag Mycronic som kommer en rapport idag som höjde vinstutsikterna 26."*

---

### ⛔ BETS-B — Betsson | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Ulf's 'kalkon': halved profit, opaque B2B (Turkey) issue, CEO refused to comment.

#### Reasoning

Profit halved following an earlier profit warning, and the B2B problem is widely understood to be Turkey but was not disclosed. Ulf says the burden of proof is larger after the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if B2B risk is clarified and resolved
- if profit recovers

> *"Bevisbördan är inte mindre efter den här rapporten, utan snarare större."*

---

### 🟢 VITR — Vitrolife | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Anna's 'kanon': beat expectations, record gross margin, US growth; possible pent-up Middle East IVF demand after peace.

#### Reasoning

Vitrolife has been a notorious disappointment but beat expectations this time, with its best gross margin so far despite the Middle East war cutting IVF volumes. The beaten-down stock could benefit from pent-up demand once peace comes.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Middle East conflict prolongs
- if the margin beat proves one-off

> *"Bruttomarginalen var den starkaste hittills."*

---

### 🟠 ELUX-B — Electrolux | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

SEK 9bn rights issue, stock -25%, heavy net debt; Ulf has a month-old buy rec but is uncertain about the Midea JV.

#### Reasoning

Ulf has had a buy recommendation for a month, but the rights issue contradicts earlier guidance. Net debt of 30bn remains high, and a colleague argued the issue should have been ~17bn. JVs are rarely a path to success, though 'we'll give them a chance'. With 17% short interest, shorts may cover via cheap rights.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Midea JV underdelivers
- if cash flow stays negative
- if a further capital raise is needed

> *"Vi får väl ge dem en chans innan vi dömer ut det."*

---

### 🟠 DYVOX — Dynavox | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Anna's 'kalkon': missed expectations, blamed weather; still considered a fine company.

#### Reasoning

Anna calls Dynavox a fine company but a 'kalkon' this quarter. Analysts suddenly cut estimates for weather effects in previews, suggesting selective guidance, and a clearer guidance policy is needed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the weather excuse repeats
- if US institutional demand weakens

> *"Det får bli Dynavox, som jag i övrigt tycker är ett väldigt fint bolag."*

---

### 🟡 TELIA — Telia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong cash flow, lower capex, on track for SEK 9bn FCF supporting dividend.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see Telia's strong cash flow as the key dividend driver and note the SEK 9bn FCF target looks reachable. The stock has already run strongly and they speculate it could pass SEK 50.

#### Sell Triggers

- if free cash flow misses the SEK 9bn target
- if capex rises

> *"Kassaflödet är ohyggligt viktigt i Telia, för det är det som bestämmer utdelningen."*
